sentences.sentence: You should always ask questions in class.
It's important to remember that you shouldn't talk while others are talking.
You can bring a snack to eat during recess.
However, you can't eat in class.
Most importantly, you must respect your classmates.
Whatever you do, you must not cheat on the test.
May I please borrow your pen?
No, you may not open your book during the test.
